intro: You shop for shoes in the online shop Pace & Sole. Do the four tasks in order.

tasks.title: Find a product
tasks.text: Add the trail running shoe Ridge Runner to the cart: size 43, color Moss.

tasks.title: Compare products
tasks.text: Add the cheapest waterproof hiking boot that is available in size 42 to the cart. Any color is correct.

tasks.title: Place the order
tasks.text: Place the order for the shoes in your cart. Use any name, e-mail and address. The data can be invented. Choose any delivery and payment.

tasks.title: Ask a question
tasks.text: Use the contact form. Ask the shop a question about your order, for example about the delivery or a return.
